name: apply_stock_movement
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_stock_movement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  insert into stock (product_id, warehouse_id, qty_on_hand)
  values (new.product_id, new.warehouse_id,
          case when new.direction = 'in' then new.quantity else -new.quantity end)
  on conflict (product_id, warehouse_id) do update
    set qty_on_hand = stock.qty_on_hand
        + case when new.direction = 'in' then new.quantity else -new.quantity end,
        updated_at = now();
  return new;
end $function$

guard_profile_role
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_profile_role()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.role is distinct from old.role and not is_owner() then
    raise exception 'Only an owner can change what access somebody has.';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

name: handle_new_user
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into profiles (id, full_name, email, role)
  values (new.id,
          coalesce(nullif(trim(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'), ''),
                   initcap(replace(split_part(new.email,'@',1),'.',' '))),
          new.email,
          'full')
  on conflict (id) do nothing;
  return new;
end $function$

name: is_owner
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_owner()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from profiles where id = auth.uid() and role = 'owner');
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.next_po_reference()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_n int;
begin
  select coalesce(max(nullif(regexp_replace(reference, '\D', '', 'g'), '')::int), 0) + 1
    into v_n from purchase_orders where reference like 'PO-%';
  return 'PO-' || lpad(v_n::text, 4, '0');
end $function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.promote_prospect()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update clients set kind = 'client'
   where id = new.client_id and kind = 'prospect';
  return null;
end $function$
